spans: the problem was never the volume.
You are sending the same message to people who want different things,
so it reads as a template to every one of them.
And a template is the one thing a busy person can delete without reading,
because deleting it costs them nothing.
Everyone tells you to send more.
So the inbox gets louder and your reply rate gets worse,
and you conclude the channel is dead.

items: You do not need a bigger list.
You do not need a new sending tool.
You need the first line to be about them.

spans: One line of real research per prospect
moves the reply rate further than doubling the send volume ever will.
Not flattery. Not their funding round.
Something that proves you actually looked.
One specific thing they said, built, shipped or complained about in public,
put in the first sentence so they know it is not a blast.
It takes about 90 seconds a prospect.
Most people will not do it.
